protocol: Four sequential fresh processes on Metal. Same 8 GiB managed budget, context and batch 4096, one 912-row target prefill, greedy seed 42, uncached handover, compact Q4_0 DFlash2 with BF16 selectors, depth 3, draft ubatch 128. Eight-input/eight-output warmup. Client TPS counts 63 intervals between token events. Original binary for the clean control. Light timestamps are buffered in memory on the inference thread, bounded by queuing IDs 1 and 64. Natural run preserves asynchronous feature injection. Fenced run synchronizes draft features, proposals and pending prompt features at their respective boundaries. In the separate expert run, existing expert counters cover only the 24 synchronized four-row verifier graphs. OS file cache uncontrolled.
interpretation: Verification graph wall includes ordinary target synchronization, expert streaming and recurrent snapshot maintenance. Explicit KV suffix truncation is timed separately for rejections and full accepts, plus routine temporary draft trimming after proposing. No full checkpoint save or replay. Expert readiness wait is consumer wall inside expert acquisition. Metal completion wait is host wall; GPU command service is nested/overlapping. These counters must not be added as independent phases. Logical model-source bytes are not physical SSD traffic. Savings targets assume unchanged round count and other phases.

natural.events_format: [phase, argument, start_us_relative_to_first_token, elapsed_us]. For emit, argument is the 1-based token index. For verify_sample it is accepted draft length. For rollback it is the number of discarded positions. Intervals are disjoint.
